description: This file defines the Goteo Controller for API endpoints related to maps, handling requests for channel data and project-matcher data to be displayed on a map, including project and workshop details and locations.

classes.name: MapsApiController
classes.description: Controller handling API requests to retrieve project and workshop data for map visualization, including channels and project matchers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, sets database replica, cache, and theme.

methods.name: channelAction
methods.description: Handles API request for a specific channel, fetching associated projects and workshops, and rendering their info for map display.

methods.name: matcherAction
methods.description: Handles API request for a project matcher, retrieving related projects and preparing their map info.
